title: cohort_demo pipeline parameters
description: Builds a samplesheet from a Metamist cohort and runs the Hail VDS combiner on Dataproc

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define input data and where the pipeline should output results.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

cohorts.description: Comma-delimited list of Metamist cohort IDs to combine.

metamist_project.description: Metamist project that owns the cohort and receives the registered output analysis.

ar_guid.description: Analysis-runner GUID used to label the Dataproc cluster/VMs for billing.

expected_sg_count.description: Expected number of sequencing groups in the cohort. The samplesheet build fails if the fetched count differs.

sequencing_type.description: Sequencing type of the cohort's sequencing groups.

input_vds.description: Previous VDS to build on, optional.

output_vds.description: Full gs:// path for the output VDS. Defaults to <outdir>/combiner/<hash>.vds when unset.

force_new.description: Ignore any saved combiner plan and start a fresh combine. Set false to resume an interrupted run.

combiner_options.title: Combiner options
combiner_options.description: Hail VDS combiner tuning. See the Hail VariantDatasetCombiner docs.

intervals.description: gs:// path to a BED (optionally gzipped) of intervals. Sets the partitioning of the gVCF import stage: one partition per interval. Read directly from GCS by the Hail job.

branch_factor.description: Number of gVCFs merged into a single intermediate VDS, and the fan-in for later VDS-to-VDS merges. Higher values mean fewer, larger tasks.

gvcf_batch_size.description: Number of intermediate VDSs built per combiner step. A step is the only checkpoint boundary, so lower values mean more frequent saves and less lost work on failure.

target_records.description: Target rows per partition when repartitioning during VDS-to-VDS merges. Has no effect on the gVCF import stage, which is partitioned by 'intervals'.

gcp_project.description: GCP project ID to create the Dataproc cluster in.

dataproc_options.title: Dataproc options
dataproc_options.description: Configuration for the Google Cloud Dataproc cluster and Hail.

dataproc_container.description: Docker image used by the process that drives the Dataproc cluster. Needs cpg-utils and the GCP Python libraries installed.

bcftools_container.description: Docker image to use for bcftools. Base image + procps.

dataproc_temp_bucket.description: GCS temp bucket for Dataproc. Also holds the combiner plan and intermediate VDSs.

dataproc_master_type.description: Machine type for the Dataproc master node, which runs the Spark driver.

dataproc_worker_type.description: Machine type for both primary and secondary Dataproc workers. The autoscaling policy caps instance count, not cores, so this is the lever for total cluster capacity.

dataproc_num_workers.description: Number of primary Dataproc worker nodes. Must sit within the autoscaling policy's workerConfig min/max.

dataproc_num_secondary_workers.description: Initial number of secondary Dataproc workers. Must sit within the autoscaling policy's secondaryWorkerConfig min/max; the autoscaler resizes from here.

preemptible_secondary_workers.description: Run secondary workers as preemptible (spot) VMs. The combiner is preemption-safe; on-demand is 2-3x the cost.

dataproc_internal_ip_only.description: Launch Dataproc VMs with internal IPs only (no external IPs). Requires Private Google Access on the subnet.

dataproc_boot_disk_size_gb.description: Per-node boot disk size in GB. Raise this if local SSDs are disabled, since Spark spills shuffle data to it.

dataproc_num_local_ssds.description: Local NVMe SSDs per node (375 GB each) for shuffle scratch. Preemptible workers draw on the PREEMPTIBLE_LOCAL_SSD_GB regional quota.

dataproc_service_account.description: Service account for the cluster VMs, so they inherit dataset access rather than using the default compute SA.

dataproc_autoscaling_policy.description: Existing autoscaling policy ID or full resource URI. If set, uses this policy instead of creating one.

dataproc_max_age.description: Cluster auto-delete TTL in seconds. The cluster is destroyed when this expires, even mid-job.

dataproc_max_idle.description: Cluster idle-delete TTL in seconds. This is the practical cost guard.
